description: drafts.json: each item has a unique id, kind governance or retirement, code (bool), target_file, heading, proposal, blast (null or a sweep/blast/<name>.json file, no '..') and for_conflict (DRAFT_ITEM). brief --kind drafter renders one live Dream Drafter Brief per item (D01, D02 in item order) with the item, its absolute blast_path and config_repo (null here: no snapshot) in the data file, and refuses a drafts.json that fails the check (the earlier render's files stay; a refused render writes nothing new).

}
